subject: Mobile Development
title: 5G: What It Actually Delivers
description: A quick win: understand 5G: What It Actually Delivers.

hook.text: 5G was promised to change everything: instant downloads, remote surgery, self-driving cars.

buildup.text: 5G offers faster speeds and lower latency, but real-world gains over 4G are often modest.

discovery.text: Millimeter-wave 5G is blazing fast but barely penetrates walls or travels more than a block.

twist.text: Most users on 5G can't tell the difference from 4G in daily use. The killer app hasn't arrived.

climax.text: 5G is revolutionary infrastructure, but its transformative applications are still being invented.

punchline.text: 5G built the highway — but the cars aren't here yet.

quiz.question: What is the main limitation of millimeter-wave 5G?
options: It barely penetrates walls or travels far
